Employee Perks

Manipal Hospitals
Benefits

Active Swiggy Group of Companies’ employees and their immediate dependents (spouse, children, and parents) can avail exclusive discounted healthcare services across the Manipal Hospitals network in India. Under the Physical Wellness pillar, this partnership provides extensive coverage on consultations, diagnostics, and self-pay treatments.

Eligibility

Active Swiggy Group of Companies’ employees and their immediate dependents (spouse, children, and parents) can avail exclusive discounted healthcare services across the Manipal Hospitals network in India. Under the Physical Wellness pillar, this partnership provides extensive coverage on consultations, diagnostics, and self-pay treatments.

All discounts mentioned are strictly applicable to self-pay services only. They cannot be routed through insurance or third-party administrators (TPAs).

The benefits for the employee and their dependents

The benefits for the employee and their dependents will be lost upon the employee's exit from Swiggy and the surrender of the official Swiggy ID card.
Any ongoing treatments or scheduled procedures post-exit will be billed at standard hospital rates.

Swiggy’s role

Manipal Hospitals

This is a healthcare perk extended by Manipal Hospitals. Swiggy is not responsible for medical advice, treatment quality, diagnosis, or hospital billing processes.
Availing services at Manipal Hospitals is entirely voluntary. Swiggy shall not be responsible for the medical outcome, customer service experience, or the usage of employees’ and dependents' personal/medical details by the hospital.
In case of any queries, service issues, or escalations, employees must directly contact Manipal Hospitals' administration or customer care.

Swiggy

Swiggy’s role is solely to facilitate the visibility of this corporate discount program; there is no commercial involvement, medical sponsorship, or liability on Swiggy’s part.
All admission procedures, billing rules, and terms of medical service will be as per Manipal Hospitals' internal policies.
Note: This is not a Swiggy-sponsored medical service. All treatments, payments, and healthcare-related matters are solely between the employee/dependent and Manipal Hospitals.

Timeline

1 yearThis partnership offer is valid for 1 year (till 16th Nov 2027) from the date of activation.
The program covers the active employee and their immediate dependents (spouse, children, and parents) only.
All discounts mentioned are strictly applicable to self-pay services only. They cannot be routed through insurance or third-party administrators (TPAs).
Inpatient service discounts exclude pharmacy, consumables, and implants.
Discounts cannot be clubbed with other ongoing promotional offers, hospital specific packages, or subsidized government schemes.
Manipal Hospitals reserves the right to amend the terms of the program or alter validation requirements at its sole discretion without prior notice.
